geometric_y_rule.rule: source ink top = floor(relative_y * unitZoom) + 1 - floor(round_half_up(nominal_height * 15/64) * unitZoom)

retained_failures: Initial HN-B explicit size 22 preparation was refused; C8 explicit 28 was also refused. Final controls use admitted C8 sizes and implicit 28. No renderer admission was relaxed.
The first held-out 84-square Latin source used CJK-only 114a and was refused before Wine. The final source uses already-admitted 094a.
Initial x-only diagnostic preparation reused a PDF filename at a second zoom and stopped before Wine; unique zoom-qualified output paths resolved it.
The initial midpoint coefficient model missed 35/312 size predictions. Its x-only diagnostic regressed 26 geometric letter cells and two original-program cells. It is not the production formula.
Original-program x/y diagnostics improve 31/54 letter cells, retain 21, and regress two at low zoom; all three full frames improve. These cells are retained, not discarded.

Initial actual 90e7b47716c3 PDF startup lost the viewer during zoom setup, admitted no visits, and retained black failure frames/crash evidence. No OOM was observed. A fresh existing bootstrap GUI route admitted all six pages.

Initial actual e1b17805a87f source-repeat pages 1/6 were stable and numerically ready but contained an information bar. Both complete-page captures were rejected. A fresh GUI-corrected session produced exact repeats.

Two pre-existing placement assertions required updated measured offsets. A new test initially attempted unsupported HN-B CJK character mode; the final test uses C8 for this behavior, without admitting new profiles.
WASM compilation passed; default copy setup could not spawn cargo under sandbox EPERM. Explicit-source copying staged the successful build for runtime verification.

The initial concurrent JavaScript run passed 191 tests and failed the corpus fake-hang 300 ms timeout fixture under load. The complete serial rerun passes all 192 tests, with no skips or JavaScript changes.
